# @danitesler/ayywi

> The AI-first design system (say "AY-wee": AI + UI). One CSS class contract for HTML, Vue, Svelte, Angular, server templates, plus typed React components, a linter and an MCP server.

Dark-first, monochrome frame with colour coming from content. Tokens are CSS custom properties prefixed --ayy-, classes are prefixed ayy-. Works in any framework; React components and custom elements render the same markup. Themes, density, brands and RTL are attributes on any element.

## Start here

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): everything in one file — rules, tokens, every component's API and examples
- [manifest/components.json](manifest/components.json): the same, as JSON
- [README.md](README.md): install and usage per framework
- [ai/AGENTS.snippet.md](ai/AGENTS.snippet.md): rules to paste into a consuming project's AGENTS.md (or run `npx @danitesler/ayywi init`)
- [ai/skills/ayywi/SKILL.md](ai/skills/ayywi/SKILL.md): how to build a page or an app with ayywi, step by step
- MCP server: `npx @danitesler/ayywi mcp` (tools: list_components, get_component, search, get_tokens, get_rules, create_brand, lint)

## Patterns

Screens every app builds the same way, from several components:

- [Settings](llms/pattern-settings.md): Settings open over the app in a near-full-screen dialog, as Notion's and Claude's do: a Settings title and the settings sections in its sidebar, one section in its main, a close button in the corner. Full screen on phones. Never a small or side dialog, never tabs inside a page.

## Components

Each links to its own page (classes, React props, accessibility, do and don't, copy-ready HTML and React); the same sections are in llms-full.txt.

### Actions

- [Button](llms/button.md): Triggers an action. Pill-shaped, monochrome primary with a subtle lift on hover.
- [Toolbar](llms/toolbar.md): A row or column of tools and actions for one surface: an editor's tools, a canvas rail, formatting over a selection. role="toolbar" makes it one Tab stop with arrow keys between items; tools that stay on are aria-pressed. Square icon buttons (or icon and label), groups, separators and a spacer; plain, vertical, floating or scrolling.
- [Dropdown menu](llms/menu.md): List of actions that opens from a button. Native popover + WAI-ARIA menu keyboard model (arrows, Home/End, type-ahead, Esc/Tab), submenus and inline expandable sections.
- [Command palette](llms/command.md): A search field over a grouped list of actions and places: type to filter, arrows to move, Enter to run. Inline in a page or popover, or as a dialog near the top of the screen opened with ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Items can show an icon, a shortcut and a count.
- [Floating action button](llms/fab.md): The one main action of a phone screen (New task, Compose, Scan), as a round button floating at the bottom inline-end corner over the content. Extended adds a label. Fixed to the viewport and clear of the home indicator; as a direct child of an App shell it sits in the shell's corner and above its bottom nav on phones.

### Navigation

- [Navbar](llms/navbar.md): Sticky site header on translucent glass: brand at the start, links and actions at the end, content centred at page width. On phones a menu button folds the links into a panel under the bar.
- [App shell](llms/app-shell.md): The frame of a web app: a sidebar beside a main area, each scrolling on its own. On phones the sidebar becomes a Bottom nav (recommended), a drawer or a sideways row. Settings reuse it inside a full-size Dialog.
- [Bottom nav](llms/bottom-nav.md): A phone app's tab bar: three to five top-level destinations, each an icon over a short label, pinned to the bottom of the screen within thumb reach and clear of the home indicator. Inside an App shell it replaces the sidebar on phones.
- [Top bar](llms/top-bar.md): A phone screen's header: a back button, the screen's title (and a subtitle), and one to three actions, sticky at the top and clear of the notch. Centred title for iOS-style screens, a large title on its own line for a tab's first screen, and an optional second row for a search bar or a segmented control.
- [Footer](llms/footer.md): The site footer at the end of every website page: brand and a line about the product, columns of links, and a bottom row for copyright and legal links. Centred at page width like the navbar.
- [Breadcrumb](llms/breadcrumb.md): Trail from the top level down to the current page (Home / Case studies / Oktopost). Plain, or a blurred pill for heroes.
- [Pagination](llms/pagination.md): Previous, page numbers with gaps, and next, for a long table or list. On phones only previous, the current page and next stay.
- [Steps](llms/steps.md): Where you are in a short flow (sign-up, checkout, import): numbered steps with the current one filled, the done ones ticked and the rest waiting. Pure CSS: aria-current="step" is the only state.
- [Contents](llms/toc.md): On-page table of contents with a scrollspy: a rail of section links where the one you're reading gets an accent bar. Optional numbers, one level of nesting, sticky beside long content.

### Forms

- [Field](llms/field.md): Form field wrapper: Label + control + hint or error, stacked with consistent spacing.
- [Input](llms/input.md): Single-line text field. Works for every native input type (text, email, search, number, file…).
- [Input group](llms/input-group.md): An input with things attached inside its box: a leading icon, a prefix or suffix, a keyboard hint, or a small button (clear, copy, show password). The group draws the field and the focus ring.
- [Search bar](llms/search-bar.md): A rounded search field with a magnifier and a clear button, and optionally a Cancel button after it, as at the top of a phone list. A <form role="search"> around an <input type="search">, so phones show a Search key. The clear button only shows while there's text.
- [Textarea](llms/textarea.md): Multi-line text field. Optional auto-grow and monospace modes.
- [Select](llms/select.md): Styled native <select>. With a mouse or trackpad its options open in ayywi's own list; touch screens keep the OS picker. Value, form behaviour and change events stay native.
- [Combobox](llms/combobox.md): An input that filters a list as you type and picks one option: a city, a customer, a time zone, a product. The WAI-ARIA combobox pattern, with the list as a popover under the input.
- [Tag input](llms/tag-input.md): A field that turns what you type into removable chips: tags, labels, email recipients. Enter or a comma adds one, pasting a comma-separated list adds them all, Backspace in the empty field removes the last. Optional suggestions open under it as you type, like a Combobox.
- [Calendar](llms/calendar.md): A month of day buttons to pick one date, inline or in a popover (DatePicker). Six weeks so the height never jumps, one Tab stop with arrow keys, today ringed, the picked day filled, days outside min/max crossed out. Optional presets (Today, Tomorrow, Next week) and a footer for a time or a Clear button.
- [Date range](llms/date-range.md): A two-month (or multi-month) calendar to pick a start and end date range, inline or in a popover (DateRangePicker). Side-by-side or stacked month grids, range start and end filled, days in between highlighted in a continuous wash band.
- [Time picker](llms/time-picker.md): Scrollable columns of hours, minutes, and optional period (AM/PM) to pick a time, inline or in a popover (TimePickerTrigger). Quiet scrollbars with scroll-snap, touch target heights driven by density tokens, and high contrast support.
- [Color picker](llms/color-picker.md): A panel to pick any colour: a 2D saturation/brightness area with a crosshair handle, hue and alpha range sliders, a preview swatch, hex input, and preset swatches.
- [Checkbox](llms/checkbox.md): Native checkbox with a drawn box, check mark and indeterminate state.
- [Radio](llms/radio.md): Native radio buttons with a drawn dot, grouped in a fieldset with a legend.
- [Segmented control](llms/segmented-control.md): Pick one of two to five options that change what you see or what you get: a date range, a view, a billing cycle. Native radios drawn as pill segments, like the tabs list.
- [Chip](llms/chip.md): Pill-shaped filters and choices: a label around a native checkbox or radio, a toggle button (aria-pressed) for apps that filter as you click, and removable chips for the filters in force. The on state is a border, a wash and a tick.
- [Swatch](llms/swatch.md): Round colour dots to pick one colour: a tag's or a list's colour, a pen in an editor. Radios in a label (or toggle buttons), coloured by --ayy-swatch set to a token, with a "no colour" and an "any colour" (native colour input) swatch. The picked one gets a ring and a tick.
- [Choice card](llms/choice-card.md): A card-sized radio or checkbox for choices that need a sentence or a price: plans, delivery options, add-ons, and compact cards for time slots and sizes. The whole card is the label of a native input.
- [Slider](llms/slider.md): A native range input with a filled track and a round thumb, and a two-thumb range for a min and a max. Keyboard, forms and screen readers work as for any range input.
- [Number field](llms/number-field.md): A native number input between minus and plus buttons, for small counts: quantities, guests, seats. Typing, arrow keys, min, max and step work as for any number input.
- [File upload](llms/dropzone.md): A drop zone that is also a file picker: a label around a native file input that covers it, so clicking opens the picker and dropping files lands on the input, with no script. Show what was picked in a List with Progress.
- [Switch](llms/switch.md): On/off toggle for a setting that applies immediately. A native checkbox with role="switch".
- [Shortcut](llms/shortcut.md): Keyboard shortcuts written once as "Mod+Shift+K" and shown for the device: ⌘ ⇧ K on Apple devices, Ctrl Shift K elsewhere, read aloud as words. Plus a recorder button that listens for a new shortcut (Esc cancels, Backspace clears), and a list of shortcuts for a help sheet.
- [Settings](llms/settings.md): Preferences as rows: a label and a one-line hint at the start, the control (Switch, Select, Shortcut recorder, Button) at the end, grouped under a heading in a card with hairlines between rows. A row can also be a link to a sub-page with the current value and a chevron, or an action like Sign out, as phone settings are.

### Layout

- [Page header](llms/page-header.md): The top of an app screen: an optional breadcrumb or eyebrow, the page title (the h1), one line of description, and the page's actions at the end — below the title on phones.
- [Card](llms/card.md): Surface that groups related content. Flat at rest with an inset top highlight; optional lift and pointer-following spotlight.
- [Tabs](llms/tabs.md): Segmented pill tabs switching between panels of related content. Full WAI-ARIA tabs keyboard support.
- [Accordion](llms/accordion.md): Questions and answers, or sections people open one at a time: native <details> in a stack with hairlines between them. Same name attribute on each and opening one closes the others.
- [Carousel](llms/carousel.md): A strip of slides that scrolls sideways and snaps, with previous/next buttons that disable at the ends. Native scrolling: swipe, trackpad and arrow keys work without JS.
- [Separator](llms/separator.md): A hairline between blocks: full, fading out at both ends (between page sections), or vertical (between inline items).

### Overlays

- [Dialog](llms/dialog.md): Modal dialog built on the native <dialog> element: top layer, inert background, focus handling and Esc for free. Centred, or a side modal (drawer, sheet) that slides in from the inline-start or inline-end edge, or a bottom sheet for phones.
- [Popover](llms/popover.md): Non-modal floating panel anchored to a button. Built on the native popover attribute: top layer, click-outside and Esc to close.
- [Tooltip](llms/tooltip.md): Short hint on hover or keyboard focus. Works with CSS alone; with React Tooltip or <ayy-tooltip> it moves to the top layer (never clipped) and flips at screen edges.

### Feedback

- [Alert](llms/alert.md): Inline message box with optional icon, title, description and actions.
- [Toast](llms/toast.md): Short, temporary notification. One framework-free toast() function renders into a shared region in the top layer (visible above dialogs). Pauses while hovered or focused.
- [Progress](llms/progress.md): Thin progress bar. Determinate (--ayy-value 0–100) or indeterminate.
- [Progress ring](llms/progress-ring.md): Progress as a ring that fills clockwise from the top: a focus timer, a daily goal, a habit's week, a small upload next to a file name. Determinate (--ayy-value 0–100) or indeterminate, with an optional value, time or icon in the middle.
- [Spinner](llms/spinner.md): An indeterminate loading ring in the text colour, sized like an icon. For short waits on a small area or inside a button; Skeleton covers content that's loading.
- [Skeleton](llms/skeleton.md): Placeholder shapes shown while content loads, with a subtle shimmer.
- [Empty state](llms/empty-state.md): What a list, table or page shows when there's nothing in it yet, or nothing matches: an optional icon tile, a title, one sentence on why, and the action that fills it.

### Data display

- [Badge](llms/badge.md): Small pill label for status, category or count. Optional pulsing status dot.
- [Keyboard hint](llms/kbd.md): A keyboard key or shortcut hint drawn as a small keycap: in help text, menus, tooltips and search fields, with platform-specific modifier adaptation (macOS ⌘/⌥, Windows Ctrl/Win, Linux Super) and international layout awareness.
- [Avatar](llms/avatar.md): Round (or square) picture of a person or workspace, with initials that show when there's no image or it fails to load.
- [Icon](llms/icon.md): Inline SVG icon from Hugeicons, ayywi's icon library: 6,000+ free Stroke Rounded icons on a 24px grid. It takes the text colour and follows the text size unless you pick one.
- [Icon tile](llms/icon-tile.md): An app-icon squircle lit from below by the content's accent, with an SVG glyph in that accent. For products, plugins and services.
- [Stat](llms/stat.md): A headline number in the heading font, with a muted unit beside it and a short label: downloads, views, results.
- [List](llms/list.md): Rows of people, records, threads or settings: leading media (avatar, icon, icon tile), a title over a description, and trailing meta or a control. A link in the title makes the whole row clickable.
- [Swipe actions](llms/swipe.md): A list row that slides sideways to show buttons underneath, as in phone mail and task apps: swipe toward the end for Done, toward the start for Snooze or Delete. Works with touch, pen and mouse, follows the reading direction, and keyboards reach the buttons with Tab.
- [Timeline](llms/timeline.md): Chronological list of events, milestones, or history with vertical connecting tracks, status markers, timestamps, and descriptions.
- [Frame](llms/frame.md): A browser window around a screenshot, video or coded mock-up: a bar with three dots and an optional address, and a long soft shadow.
- [Chat](llms/chat.md): A conversation: incoming bubbles at the start edge, the reader's own inverted at the end, a typing indicator and quick-reply buttons.
- [Code block](llms/code-block.md): Formatted code container with header, filename, copy button, line numbers, and token styling for syntax highlighting.
- [Table](llms/table.md): Data table with quiet hairlines, uppercase headers and hover rows. Styles plain table elements under .ayy-table.
- [Chart](llms/chart.md): Charts drawn by CSS with no library: columns (grouped or stacked), lines and areas, a ranked bar list and sparklines. Bars and ticks take --ayy-value (0–100), lines are SVG paths from chartPath(). Series colours are the chart tokens in order, so a chart library can match them.
